footer.description: අධ්‍යාපනය, මඟපෙන්වීම සහ පොදු ඉගෙනුම් සම්පත් මඟින් ඉගෙනීම දිරිමත් කරමු.

home.title: ඉගෙන ගන්න, දියුණු වන්න, ඔබේ අනාගතය ගොඩනඟන්න.
home.description: අපගේ වැඩසටහන් හඳුනාගෙන, අධ්‍යාපනික සම්පත් ගවේෂණය කර, අපගේ කණ්ඩායම අමතන්න.
home.servicesDescription: Discover learning opportunities and support designed to help you move forward.
home.resourcesDescription: Browse educational materials to support your learning and personal development.
home.ctaDescription: Take the next step and register your interest in our programmes.

about.title: අප ගැන
about.description: අපගේ ආයතනය, එහි අරමුණ සහ අධ්‍යාපනය සඳහා ඇති කැපවීම පිළිබඳව දැනගන්න.

services.title: අපගේ සේවාවන්
services.description: අප විසින් සපයනු ලබන අධ්‍යාපන වැඩසටහන්, මඟපෙන්වීම් සහ සේවාවන් ගවේෂණය කරන්න.

resources.title: ඉගෙනුම් සම්පත්
resources.description: අපගේ ආයතනය හරහා ලබාගත හැකි අධ්‍යාපනික ද්‍රව්‍ය සහ ඉගෙනුම් සම්පත් බලන්න.

contact.title: අප අමතන්න
contact.description: ප්‍රශ්නයක් තිබේද? අපගේ සම්බන්ධතා තොරතුරු ලබාගෙන අපගේ කණ්ඩායම අමතන්න.

preregister.title: පූර්ව ලියාපදිංචිය
preregister.description: අපගේ වැඩසටහන් සඳහා ඔබේ උනන්දුව ලියාපදිංචි කරන්න. වැඩිදුර තොරතුරු පසුව මෙහි ලබාදෙනු ඇත.

privacy-policy.title: පෞද්ගලිකත්ව ප්‍රතිපත්තිය
privacy-policy.description: මෙම වෙබ් අඩවිය හරහා ඉදිරිපත් කරන පුද්ගලික තොරතුරු හැසිරවීමට අප අදහස් කරන ආකාරය දැනගන්න.

terms-of-use.title: භාවිත නියමයන්
terms-of-use.description: මෙම වෙබ් අඩවිය සහ එහි අධ්‍යාපනික සම්පත් භාවිත කිරීමේ පොදු නියමයන් කියවන්න.

shared.sampleText: මෙය තාවකාලික අන්තර්ගතයකි. ආයතනයේ තහවුරු කළ තොරතුරු පසුව එක් කරනු ලැබේ.

notFound.title: පිටුව හමු නොවීය
notFound.message: කණගාටුයි, ඔබ සොයන පිටුව සොයාගත නොහැක. එය වෙනස් කර තිබිය හැකිය, නැතහොත් ලිපිනය වැරදි විය හැකිය.

resourcesLibrary.title: සම්පත් පුස්තකාලය
resourcesLibrary.description: අධ්‍යාපනික ද්‍රව්‍ය සහ ප්‍රයෝජනවත් ඉගෙනුම් සම්පත් ගවේෂණය කරන්න.
resourcesLibrary.paidNotice: මෙම සම්පත ලබාගැනීමට ගෙවීමක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. මාර්ගගත ගෙවීම් පහසුකම පසුව හඳුන්වා දෙනු ඇත.
resourcesLibrary.sampleNotice: නියැදි සම්පත් ලැයිස්තුව — සැබෑ සම්පත් පසුව එක් කරනු ඇත.

contactForm.subject: මාතෘකාව

aboutPage.introduction: We are an educational institution committed to making knowledge, learning opportunities, and practical resources accessible to our community.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To support lifelong learning by providing accessible educational programmes, useful resources, and opportunities for personal development.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To build a community where people can develop their knowledge, strengthen their abilities, and pursue meaningful opportunities.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: We value accessibility, integrity, respect, continuous improvement, and a commitment to the learning needs of our community.

servicesPage.introduction: Explore the educational programmes, guidance, and learning resources available through our institute. The details below are sample content and will be updated to reflect our actual services.

education.title: Educational Programmes
education.description: Sample programmes designed to help learners develop knowledge, practical skills, and confidence.

consultation.title: Guidance and Consultation
consultation.description: Sample guidance services to help individuals identify learning goals and explore suitable opportunities.

resources.title: Learning Resources
resources.description: Educational materials and reference resources to support independent study and continued learning.

legalPage.reviewNotice: Draft content for review. Please confirm that this policy accurately describes the institute's actual practices before publication.

privacy.introduction: This draft explains how the institute intends to handle information associated with visits to this website and enquiries made through its forms. The final policy must be checked against the website's actual operation.

information.title: Information We May Collect
information.content: Visitors may provide their name, email address, phone number, selected programme, and enquiry details when using our forms. Technical information may also be processed by the website hosting provider, depending on the hosting and analytics services enabled.

usage.title: How Information Is Used
usage.content: Information may be used to respond to enquiries, follow up on programme interests, provide requested information, and maintain website security. The institute should document any additional purposes before collecting information for them.

forms.title: Contact and Pre-registration Forms
forms.content: At present, the forms are demonstration interfaces. They validate entries in the visitor's browser but do not send the submitted details to the institute or save them in an institute database. This statement must be updated when server-side submission and email delivery are implemented.

sharing.title: Sharing of Information
sharing.content: The institute does not intend to sell visitors' personal information. If third-party hosting, email, analytics, or other services process information, the final policy should identify the relevant services and explain the applicable arrangements.

security.title: Data Security and Retention
security.content: Reasonable safeguards should be used to protect personal information. Retention periods, access controls, backup practices, and procedures for handling security incidents must be established and documented before the website begins collecting personal information.

rights.title: Your Privacy Choices
rights.content: Depending on applicable law and the circumstances, visitors may have rights to request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal information, or to object to certain processing. The institute should provide an appropriate process for handling such requests.

contact.title: Contact Us About Privacy
contact.content: For privacy-related questions, contact the institute using the contact details published on this website. Replace this general statement with the institute's designated privacy contact before publication.

terms.introduction: These draft terms describe the intended conditions for using the institute's website and public resources. They should be reviewed and approved before publication.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of These Terms
acceptance.content: By using this website, visitors are expected to use it lawfully and responsibly. The institute should confirm the final terms and how acceptance will be communicated before publication.

websiteUse.title: Permitted Use
websiteUse.content: Visitors may browse public pages and use available features for lawful purposes. Visitors must not attempt to disrupt the website, bypass access restrictions, interfere with other users, or misuse website content or services.

resources.title: Educational Resources and Downloads
resources.content: Resource descriptions and access labels are provided to explain the materials offered. Free resources may be downloaded when the download feature is available. Resources marked as paid are not available for free download. Any future purchase, licence, or access conditions must be displayed clearly before payment or access is granted.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: Unless otherwise stated, website text, branding, and educational materials may be protected by intellectual property laws. Visitors must obtain the appropriate permission before reproducing, redistributing, or commercially using protected materials, except where applicable law permits such use.

accuracy.title: Information and Availability
accuracy.content: Website content may be updated, corrected, or removed. Sample text, sample programmes, and demonstration resources are illustrative only and should not be treated as confirmed institutional offerings.

externalLinks.title: External Websites
externalLinks.content: This website may link to third-party services or websites. The institute does not control their content or practices and should not be assumed to endorse them solely because a link is provided.

liability.title: Limitations and Responsibilities
liability.content: The website is provided for general informational and educational purposes. Any limitations of responsibility must be drafted and reviewed in accordance with applicable law; this draft does not establish a legally enforceable exclusion of liability.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.content: The institute may revise these terms when its website or services change. The published version should display an appropriate effective or last-updated date and explain how material changes will be communicated where necessary.

contact.title: Questions About These Terms
contact.content: For questions about these terms, contact the institute using the contact details published on this website.
